notes:
Summary: Bristlecone builds a cloud contact-center platform used by retailers and telco support teams. Evaluating Redwood for agent-assist + ticket summarization + RAG over heterogeneous KBs. Preference for VPC/private control plane for enterprise customers.

Key requirements:
- RAG fidelity: must return inline citations pointing to original KB doc with sentence offsets; highlight freshness metadata (ingestion timestamp + last-touch).
- Multi-source retrieval: combine product docs, past tickets, and call transcripts; allow provenance tagging and per-source boosting.
- Freshness & sync: incremental sync daily, hot-path for recent 7d changes; delta ingestion + vector upserts.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 agent-assist latency <120ms (text-only), sustained throughput 500 reqs/s for peak-shift windows; embedding upsert throughput ~10k vectors/min during bulk imports.
- Reliability during spikes: graceful degradation to smaller model or cached answers; must tolerate 3x baseline traffic for Black Friday-like events.
- Tool-calling: function calls to internal CRM to fetch customer context + ticket thread append (idempotent).
- Observability: per-route latency/cost breakdown, token-level cost attribution, retriever hit-rate metrics, evals tied to prompt sets.

POC scope discussed:
- 4-week pilot: ingest ~120k KB docs (articles + 2 years of tickets) into vector store, wire agent UI to Redwood Dedicated endpoint, run canary on 10 agents then ramp to 200.
- Eval plan: set 200 prompt/test pairs for precision/recall on citations, run nightly regression checks.

- 2026-02-20: Intro call, product fit confirmed; Fireflies note ff_20260220_2190. AE shared high-level pricing.

Quotes / calls notes:

- "If we can't guarantee p95 under spikes, we won't move production traffic." — VP Engineering.

Tech constraints / notes for SE:
- KB formats: markdown articles, Zendesk tickets export (JSON), Parquet call transcripts (segmented). Need connectors or recommended ingestion pipeline.
- Retrieval filtering: must support metadata filters by product/version, region, and ticket status.
- Vector store: open to managed or bring-your-own; prefer ability to snapshot and restore indexes.
- Models: prefer open-model variants with fallback to smaller low-cost models for high-throughput short-turn queries.

Next steps (short):
- Send standard NDA (legal).
- Request sample KB export + sample 1k tickets for retrieval quality checks.
- Provide pilot SOW + pricing for Dedicated capacity; include burst policy options.

Short-term blockers: legal/data residency clause in enterprise contract; SSO integration timing; confirming cost projection for 1M queries/month.
